## Findings

- [ ] **[Coverage/WARN] `SymairaIngestContract.SymingestContractError` only 53.6% line coverage**
  - **Status quo:** `Sources/SymairaIngestContract/SymingestContractError.swift:15-28` — error enum with cases `invalidRule`, `invalidReOCRRequest`, `encodingFailed`, `decodingFailed`, `networkError`, `serverError`. Several cases are never thrown in tests.
  - **Likely cause:** Tests focus on happy-path contract serialization; error constructors are only hit via fuzzing or negative tests which don't exist.
  - **Proposed solution:** Add unit tests that directly instantiate each error case and assert `errorDescription` / `localizedDescription`. Low effort, closes the gap.
  - **Uncovered:** `Sources/SymairaIngestContract/SymingestContractError.swift:15-28` (cases `invalidReOCRRequest`, `encodingFailed`, `decodingFailed`, `networkError`, `serverError` in `enum SymingestContractError`)
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / medium impact

- [ ] **[Coverage/WARN] `SymairaMCP.MCPTypes` only 67.6% line / 54.3% function coverage**
  - **Status quo:** `Sources/SymairaMCP/MCPTypes.swift` defines many MCP message types (`InitializeRequest`, `InitializeResult`, `ToolCall`, `ToolResult`, `ResourceRead`, etc.). Most variants are not constructed in tests.
  - **Likely cause:** New module; tests in `MCPServerTests.swift` exercise the server loop but not all type permutations.
  - **Proposed solution:** Add round-trip encoding/decoding tests for each public MCP type. Use `JSONEncoder`/`JSONDecoder` with the snake_case strategy and assert structural equality.
  - **Uncovered:** `Sources/SymairaMCP/MCPTypes.swift` (multiple structs/enums: `InitializeRequest`, `ToolCall`, `ToolResult`, `ResourceRead`, `ResourceList`, `PromptGet`, etc.)
  - **Effort/Impact:** Medium effort / medium impact

- [ ] **[Coverage/WARN] `SymairaTheme.FormComponents` 78.2% line / 75% function coverage**
  - **Status quo:** `Sources/SymairaTheme/FormComponents.swift` — `SymairaFormSection`, `SymairaFormRow` builders. Missing coverage on `@MainActor` isolated initializers and some builder closures.
  - **Likely cause:** Tests instantiate but don't fully exercise all builder variants (e.g., `SymairaFormRow` with/without description, `SymairaFormSection` with/without title/footer).
  - **Proposed solution:** Add test cases for each builder permutation. The `@MainActor` annotation requires `@MainActor` on test methods (see Code Review finding).
  - **Uncovered:** `Sources/SymairaTheme/FormComponents.swift:2-51` (initializers and body properties of `SymairaFormSection`, `SymairaFormRow`)
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / low impact

- [ ] **[Coverage/WARN] `SymairaUpdateCheck.AppUpdateChecker` 71.4% line / 53.8% function coverage**
  - **Status quo:** `Sources/SymairaUpdateCheck/AppUpdateChecker.swift` — network fetch, caching, version comparison. Error paths (network failure, malformed JSON, missing asset) are lightly tested.
  - **Likely cause:** Tests use a local file cache but don't mock `URLSession` for error injection.
  - **Proposed solution:** Introduce a `URLSession` protocol abstraction or use `URLProtocol` mocking to simulate network errors, 404s, and malformed responses. Assert the checker surfaces `UpdateCheckError` correctly.
  - **Uncovered:** `Sources/SymairaUpdateCheck/AppUpdateChecker.swift:28-56` (functions `fetchLatestRelease`, `parseRelease`, `compareVersions` error branches)
  - **Effort/Impact:** Medium effort / high impact

- [ ] **[Coverage/WARN] `SymairaDaemonKit.DaemonSupervisor` 84.8% line / 84.6% function coverage**
  - **Status quo:** `Sources/SymairaDaemonKit/DaemonSupervisor.swift` — process launch, monitoring, restart logic. Some signal-handling and crash-loop backoff paths untested.
  - **Likely cause:** Tests verify basic start/stop; edge cases (rapid restarts, signal delivery, stdout/stderr pipe closure) require more elaborate fixtures.
  - **Proposed solution:** Add tests for `restartPolicy` backoff, `terminationHandler` on crash, and pipe-drain behavior. Consider a fake `Process` substitute for deterministic control.
  - **Uncovered:** `Sources/SymairaDaemonKit/DaemonSupervisor.swift:69-356` (functions `start`, `monitor`, `restartWithBackoff`, signal handling)
  - **Effort/Impact:** Medium effort / medium impact
